title: The End of a Sweet Dream
subtitle: It's the sound of bells, the knocking of doors, the rumble of an approaching rain.

items.text: The End of a Sweet Dream
"The children, soaring over sleepy houses and the sparkling sea, finally reach the dreamy island."
"The tide loves them so much it rolls itself into a blanket to welcome them."
"The fairies gather around, plucking waves and stars to crown them."
"The joyous children climb the highest cliffs above the sea."
"But don't get too comfortable, and don't let your guard down."
"Children. When dusk falls upon the island, you'll know it's coming."
Curfew holds no sway over these nimble little feet.
Three shadows tiptoe by the silent lakeshore. Even the smallest cough would shatter the stillness in the air.
But the silence can only last so long, and despite their best efforts to keep quiet, a voice slips out.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Say, do you think that critter will really take us as its masters?

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Strange... It dug a hole there under its butt, put the can of food inside, then spat on it.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Boss, maybe we should try something else...

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Sancho, how does your knowledge of critters suck so much? The instructor literally explained this morning that glavakus use their spit to distinguish food from trash.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Right, right. The instructors may be boring, but they do spout some wisdom.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: One day, this big boy will willingly serve us and be our obedient mount!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Also, there's a saying. How does it go? “When God locks the door, he leaves a window open through which we may slip out.”

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Uh, Jarl, I don’t think that’s—

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Hey, duck down! Duck down! The witch is coming again!

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Don't step on my foot! Gah! I literally just polished these shoes tonight!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Shush! She's coming!
Their hands meet their faces as they huddle together.
The witch hurries past. She pauses at a critter cage on the other side of the room.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: "Oh... glavakus Number 15, why do you have diarrhea again?! I've been feeding you exactly according to the 'Critter Feeding Manual'..."

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Someone else must be feeding you...

items.speaker: Glawackus
items.text: *Brrrr*...
The poor creature, unable to speak, curls up in distress.
Dejected, the three unreliable "masters" sneak away.
As the night deepens, they return to the dormitory.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Ugh, I have to go to class all sweaty again tomorrow...

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Ha-ha-ha, you smell just like that critter! Maybe it'll even take you as its leader.
Eifer's face turns red. She pinches his arm hard.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Hmph! I'll put a curse on you to be thrown out of school tonight! Not even the instructors can protect you then!

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: You’ll be like a soap bubble floating in the sewer!

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Hey, Eifer, don't...
Sancho suddenly turns solemn. He shakes his head, signaling her to stop.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: ...Boss’s family.
The jarl's smile fades, and worry fills her eyes.
Eifer immediately feels guilty.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Sorry, Erick, I was just saying.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Your dad and grandpa must be—

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Duck! Hide behind the wall!
Erick clasps her hands over their mouths, instantly muffling their voices.
A suspicious looking figure lurks by a red postbox nearby.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Looks like someone's up to no good with our mailbox...

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Ewww... Boss, why does your hand smell weird?

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Oh, sorry, I patted the glavakus's butt earlier.
She quickly lowers her hand, shaking it as if doing so could rid the stink.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Ginger hair, checkered headband... hey, isn't that the distinguished alumna, Sonetto?!

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Oh... her hair is so pretty! Much prettier than my sister's. When I graduate, I want to dye mine the color of the leaves in autumn.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Isn’t she the one who was top of the class in Potion Studies, Basic Arcanism, and Critter Training a few years ago?! Move your head, I want to see too!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Nothing to fuss over, crew. She may be great, but she's just one of my former opponents. For a bard, she’s—

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Strange, is she mailing something? But these aren’t the non-student mailboxes...

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Look, she's stuffing a letter in there. But that's... that's...!
Having completed the task, the Sonetto hurries away.
As silence returns under the night sky, Erick dashes to her mailbox, pulling out the letter.
"To Erick..." The sender had falsely signed "...Harald" at the bottom.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Boss, why did you run so fast... Oh, is this a gift from Sonetto?! I thought everyone's mail was delivered by the postman during the day...

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Hey, Boss...?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Don't worry, during the term, Harald will still... send you letters every month. The school postman is very punctual.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You can write to him too; your communication will be unhindered...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We promised him that we would ensure your safety at school.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: He trusts you can handle this. I’m certain you will.
"You can trust these two, they’re good people. —Yours forever, Harald."

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Have they been lying?

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Besides the first, all the letters were...

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: If it’s all a lie, then what’s the point of all this?

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: The treasure, territories, crew... what’s the point of my ambitions?

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Hey, Boss?

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: ...Ever since you got that letter yesterday, you've been acting a bit strange.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Erick... Erick!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Oh... sorry, what were you saying?

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: What's wrong?

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: N-Nothing, just leave me be.
Her gaze becomes vacant again, as if all this weren’t real.
Steady footsteps approach from a distance.
The students watch the advancing figure, lips firmly sealed.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Erick, there is a suspicion that you snuck off to the critter shed by the lake yesterday and fed the critters there. As I’m sure you’re aware, this is against the school rules.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: As of right now, there's no second witness to prove it was you. But, if it was you...
Eifer stands up.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Sh-She was with us the whole time yesterday, I can testify!

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: I can too!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: It was me.
Erick stands up, arms dropping to her sides...
TO BE CONTINUED…
